basic_info.description: Stunning VIEWS and more VIEWS from every room in this special Brannan unit. First time on the market in over 24 years. Panoramic views of the iconic Bay Bridge, Water, Downtown Skyline, Embarcadero Waterfront and Piers along with the Marina. If you've ever wanted that classic, uncomparable San Francisco view unit this is it! Unit 12H also offers expansive windows, excellent natural light, 2 bedrooms, 2 full baths and walk out view terrace. Also included is 1 car parking with EV charger and storage. The BRANNAN was designed by renowned French interior designer Christian Liaigre, the interiors at The Brannan are a true reflection of timeless elegance. Inspired by the historic San Francisco Waterfront, the residences at The Brannan exude a refined aesthetic with luxurious finishes and attention to detail throughout. The Brannan offers a full service of luxury amenities that include 24-hr security, a door person in each tower, heated 75 ft. lap pool, jacuzzi, gym/fitness center, concierge services, spa and BBQ area. Located 1 block from the Embarcadero Waterfront, close to Ferry Building Plaza, Farmers Market, Oracle Park (Giants), Chase Center (Warriors), Caltrain, shops, world-class restaurants and close to all forms of transportation.
